using System.Text;
using System.Text.Json;
using System.Text.Json.Nodes;
using Ferrule.Generated;
using Ferrule.Runtime;

static void Verify(FerruleInstance actual, JsonElement expected)
{
    switch (expected.ValueKind)
    {
        case JsonValueKind.Object:
            if (actual is not FerruleGroup group || group.Fields.Count != expected.EnumerateObject().Count()) throw new Exception("Whole group differs");
            foreach (var property in expected.EnumerateObject()) Verify(group.Fields.Single(field => field.Name == property.Name).Value, property.Value);
            break;
        case JsonValueKind.Array:
            if (actual is not FerruleRepeated repeated || repeated.Items.Count != expected.GetArrayLength()) throw new Exception("Whole sequence differs");
            for (int index = 0; index < repeated.Items.Count; index++) Verify(repeated.Items[index], expected[index]);
            break;
        case JsonValueKind.Number:
            if (actual is not FerruleScalar number || number.Value.Kind != FerruleValueKind.Int64 || number.Value.Int64Value != expected.GetInt64()) throw new Exception("Integer count differs");
            break;
        case JsonValueKind.String:
            if (actual is not FerruleScalar text || text.Value.Kind != FerruleValueKind.String || text.Value.StringValue != expected.GetString()) throw new Exception("Text differs");
            break;
        default: throw new Exception("Outside authored output domain");
    }
}

static void Refuses(Action action)
{
    try { action(); }
    catch (FerruleX12Exception) { return; }
    throw new Exception("Malformed whole X12 was accepted");
}

using var cases = JsonDocument.Parse(File.ReadAllText("cases.json"));
foreach (var test in cases.RootElement.EnumerateArray())
{
    string wire = test.GetProperty("input").GetString()!;
    byte[] bytes = Encoding.UTF8.GetBytes(wire);
    if (test.TryGetProperty("reject", out var reject) && reject.GetBoolean())
    {
        Refuses(() => GeneratedMapping.ParseX12(wire));
        Refuses(() => GeneratedMapping.ParseX12Bytes(bytes));
        Refuses(() => GeneratedMapping.ExecuteX12ToJson(wire));
        Refuses(() => GeneratedMapping.ExecuteX12ToJsonBytes(bytes));
        continue;
    }
    var expected = test.GetProperty("expected");
    Verify(GeneratedMapping.Execute(GeneratedMapping.ParseX12(wire)), expected);
    Verify(GeneratedMapping.Execute(GeneratedMapping.ParseX12Bytes(bytes)), expected);
    foreach (string json in new[] { GeneratedMapping.ExecuteX12ToJson(wire), Encoding.UTF8.GetString(GeneratedMapping.ExecuteX12ToJsonBytes(bytes)) })
        if (!JsonNode.DeepEquals(JsonNode.Parse(json), JsonNode.Parse(expected.GetRawText()))) throw new Exception($"Whole output differs: {json}");
}
Console.WriteLine($"EDI group-count Release cases: {cases.RootElement.GetArrayLength()}");
